purpose: Universal text-free cover artwork, composed with editable frontend typography

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story / book cover material. Create ONE portrait 2:3 image, ideally 1024x1536, full bleed edge-to-edge FLAT FRONT COVER PRINT ARTWORK suitable as an image layer beneath editable Chinese typography in a real frontend. This is the actual printable cover surface, NOT a physical book mockup, NOT a photograph of a book on a table, NOT a comparison board. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO typography, NO numerals, NO glyphs, NO logos, NO watermarks, NO fake writing. No external backdrop, no perspective, no book spine, no corner shadows. Sophisticated independent publishing design with excellent tactile material definition. Soft even diffuse frontal light that reveals shallow paper/fabric texture; no dramatic overall lighting gradient or shadow that would reduce legibility. Precise restrained composition, rich authentic texture, professional beautiful graphic art rather than generic AI fantasy. All the edges are artwork and may be cropped a tiny amount by a book UI. Preserve a clear quiet area for frontend title text described below and clean bottom strip for author text. Art direction: CLOTHBOUND ARCHIVE / 布面典藏. Full surface sumptuous midnight indigo buckram bookbinding linen, ultra-fine authentic woven warp and weft, visible but subtle tactile material. Palette nearly black navy #152b3e, warm antique metallic gold, hints of aged copper. Fine beautifully crafted restrained embossed gold geometrical botanical book ornament concentrated ONLY in the lower half: an elegant art deco arch with an intricate small symmetrical ginkgo leaf or seedpod etching inside, a small ascending fan, very delicate precision gold foil linework that catches soft light. Thin hairline gold rectangular inset border with considered small open corners, at most one frame. TOP 48% of the cover must be mostly uninterrupted dark indigo linen, generous quiet space to place a large two-line Chinese title on upper left, not an actual empty white text box. Lower ornament occupies middle 48%–86% of height, enough detail to feel like a treasured hardcover, not an overworked ancient magic tome. Bottom 8% a calm dark indigo strip without a rule for editable author text. Flat print artwork, strongest material and craft quality. No literal objects beyond ornamental graphic.

Restrained expressive crafted printmaking, fine hand-rendered landscape detail, crisp yet atmospheric. No people, no architecture, no calligraphy, no seals.

Physical paper fibers, slight offset printed registration and subtle ink bleed, premium art-book design. No symbols, no frame, no simulated typography.
